BiblicalUsage: Gechazi is a person named 12 times in Scripture, in 2 Kings. No People profile carries this name, so I note the name’s use here and go no further.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Gechazi in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
